newsitem.title: USA: Chateau urges stockholders to keep shares.
newsitem.headline: Chateau urges stockholders to keep shares.

text.p: Chateau Properties Inc Wednesday urged its stockholders again not to tender their shares to Manufactured Home Communities Inc, despite the extension of MHC's hostile tender offer.

MHC said earlier that it extended its cash tender offer of $26 a share for Chateau Properties Inc stock through October 23. In addition, MHC said it also will consider amending its bid, including offering a tax-deferred option for operating partnership unit holders and enhancing its offer to shareholders and partnership unit holders seeking immediate liquidity.
In response to MHC's extension, Chateau Properties issued the following statement:

"The majority of long-term Chateau stockholders understand and appreciate the substantial benefits inherent in our strategic merger with ROC Communities (Inc ). Keep in mind our estimate that up to 40 percent of the shares of Chateau common stock may be held by professional arbitrageurs and other short-term holders, who we surmise own a substantial portion of the tendered shares.

"We strongly urge Chateau stockholders not to tender into the MHC offer. For those who have, we recommend that they carefully review the significant conditions to the MHC offer, which have neither been fulfilled nor waived, and exercise their right to withdraw their shares."
